hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(gs|html)$ ]]; then echo "" >&2; echo "========================================" >&2; echo "ANTES DE MODIFICAR CODIGO - CHECKLIST" >&2; echo "========================================" >&2; echo "" >&2; echo "1. DOCUMENTOS A LEER (si no lo hiciste):" >&2; echo "   - CLAUDE.md (instrucciones del proyecto)" >&2; echo "   - CHANGELOG.md (cambios recientes)" >&2; echo "   - docs/LECCIONES_APRENDIDAS.md (errores a evitar)" >&2; echo "" >&2; echo "2. AUTORIZACION REQUERIDA:" >&2; echo "   Archivo: $FILE" >&2; echo "   Debes describir el cambio y esperar aprobacion explicita." >&2; echo "   Si ya tienes aprobacion, puedes continuar." >&2; echo "" >&2; echo "3. RECUERDA:" >&2; echo "   - Verificar null en getElementById()" >&2; echo "   - Usar withFailureHandler en google.script.run" >&2; echo "   - No crear codigo muerto" >&2; echo "========================================" >&2; fi'

bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(gs|html)$ ]]; then echo "" >&2; echo "========================================" >&2; echo "DESPUES DE MODIFICAR CODIGO - VERIFICAR" >&2; echo "========================================" >&2; OPEN=$(grep -o "{" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | wc -l); CLOSE=$(grep -o "}" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$OPEN" -ne "$CLOSE" ]; then echo "ERROR: Llaves desbalanceadas en $FILE" >&2; echo "  Abiertas: $OPEN | Cerradas: $CLOSE" >&2; else echo "OK: Llaves balanceadas ($OPEN/{/$CLOSE})" >&2; fi; echo "" >&2; echo "ACCIONES POST-EDICION:" >&2; echo "1. Ejecutar /verify-system para verificacion completa" >&2; echo "2. Probar el flujo afectado en TODAS las pestanas" >&2; echo "3. Verificar consola del navegador (F12)" >&2; echo "4. Actualizar CHANGELOG.md si es cambio significativo" >&2; echo "========================================" >&2; fi'

bash -c 'echo "" >&2; echo "========================================" >&2; echo "VERIFICACION FINAL DE SESION" >&2; echo "========================================" >&2; cd /home/user/Sistema-NeuroTEA-en-Google 2>/dev/null || exit 0; echo "" >&2; echo "1. VERIFICACION DE IDs HTML vs JS:" >&2; JS_IDS=$(grep -oE "getElementById\([\x27\"]([^\x27\"]+)[\x27\"]\)" gas/Scripts.html 2>/dev/null | sed "s/.*getElementById([\x27\"]//;s/[\x27\"].*)//" | sort -u); HTML_IDS=$(grep -oE "id=\"([^\"]+)\"" gas/Index.html 2>/dev/null | sed "s/id=\"//;s/\"//" | sort -u); MISSING=$(comm -23 <(echo "$JS_IDS") <(echo "$HTML_IDS") 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^chevron-" | grep -v "^sessions-" | grep -v "^tab-" | grep -v "^transfers-" | grep -v "^conflict-" | head -5); if [ -n "$MISSING" ]; then echo "   ADVERTENCIA - IDs en JS sin HTML (no dinamicos):" >&2; echo "$MISSING" | sed "s/^/   - /" >&2; else echo "   OK: Todos los IDs estaticos existen" >&2; fi; echo "" >&2; echo "2. RECORDATORIOS:" >&2; echo "   - Actualizar CHANGELOG.md con cambios" >&2; echo "   - Documentar lecciones aprendidas si aplica" >&2; echo "   - Commit con mensaje descriptivo" >&2; echo "========================================" >&2'
